popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus makes Perieres son of Aeolus king of Messene, husband of Gorgophone, father of Aphareus and Leucippus — and in the same reckoning Tyndareus and Icarius — the Aeolid hinge of Messenian and Spartan descent.

popCulture.title: Perieres (king of Messenia)
popCulture.description: Aeolid prince of Messene — carefully kept distinct from genealogies that make Perieres a Spartan son of Cynortas or collapse him with Oebalus.

popCulture.title: Gorgophone
popCulture.description: Perieres' wife, daughter of Perseus — the widow who later marries Oebalus, tying Messenian and Spartan houses through one Perseid bride.

popCulture.title: Aphareus
popCulture.description: Perieres' son — king of Messene and father of Idas and Lynceus, the Apharetidae of the Dioscuri quarrel.
